items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-02-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mealy Bonds, 7th of February 1962. Can you remember your birth date, Mealy?

ctx.x: Mealy Bonds, 7th of February 1962. Can you remember your birth date, Mealy?
Yeah, I'll be at the rate of, I was going to say, 70 years old, only 18 of this month.
